description: This file defines a class 'UrlNode' and a function 'getSortedRoutes' for managing and sorting route paths in a Next.js project, handling dynamic segments and route hierarchy.

classes.name: UrlNode
classes.description: A class representing a node in a route tree, managing route segments, including dynamic and catch-all segments, and generating sorted route paths.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a URL path into the route tree, breaking it into segments.

methods.name: smoosh
methods.description: Generates a sorted list of route paths from the route tree.

methods.name: _smoosh
methods.description: Internal method that recursively constructs route strings with proper sorting, handling special route segments.

methods.name: _insert
methods.description: Internal method that inserts route segments into the tree, managing dynamic segments and catch-all routes.
